title: Leo Sprinkle finds Benowitz armed and saying 'they're coming'
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Leo Sprinkle finds Benowitz armed and saying 'they're coming', about late 1970s-1980 at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Benowitz home, Four Hills, Albuquerque, New Mexico

tellings.quote: he said Bennis was there with like a like a rifle and a pistol and he said, you know, they're coming. You have to come in the house right now.

plain: A writer, Greg Bishop, passes on a story from a psychologist named Leo Sprinkle about a visit to the Albuquerque home of a man named Paul Bennewitz in the late 1970s. Sprinkle said Bennewitz met him holding a rifle and a pistol and told him, "they're coming, you have to come in the house right now." Bishop tells it to show how frightened Bennewitz had become, in a story about a man he says was driven to madness by what he believed were aliens.
